turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.text: Sanibonani. Le module imayelana nokuqonda imisindo kanye nolwazi lwemisindo.
turns.en: Hello everyone. This module is about phonological awareness and phonics.

turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.text: Siyazi ukuthi izingane zifika ebangeni lika-grade R sezikwazi ukukhuluma.
turns.en: We know that children arrive in grade R already knowing how to speak.

turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.text: Njengothisha, sikhuthaza ukuthi uxoxe nabo cishe ngayo yonke into.
turns.en: As a teacher, we encourage that you talk with them about almost everything.

turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.text: Yingakho kubalulekile ukugxilisa ulwazi lwemisindo ukuze bawuzwe umsindo indlela obizwa ngayo.
turns.en: That is why it is important to instill phonics so that they hear the sound, the way it is pronounced.

turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.text: ukuze bawuzwe umsindo, indlela obizwa ngayo, bakwazi nokuwehlukanisa ngokuwuzwa.
turns.en: so that they hear the sound, the way it is pronounced, and they are also able to distinguish it by hearing it.

turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.text: Ingxenye yokuqala ye-module iphathelene nokuqonda imisindo.
turns.en: The first part of the module is about phonological awareness.

turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.text: Ingxenye yesibili ye-module ikhuluma ngolwazi lwemisindo.
turns.en: The second part of the module talks about phonics.

turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.text: Emuva kokuqeda le-module, uzokwazi ukuhlukanisa kanye nokuqonda imisindo ehlukahlukene.
turns.en: After finishing this module, you will be able to distinguish and understand different sounds.

turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.text: Ukubaluleka kokuqonda imisindo nokwazi ukuqonda imisindo.
turns.en: The importance of phonological awareness and knowing how to understand sounds.
